==Format==
* '''Rounds 1-2''' - ''April 2<sup>nd</sup> - June 1<sup>st</sup>, 2025''
** Double round-robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|Top 6 teams}} qualify for [[/Road to MSI|Road to MSI]]
* '''Rounds 3-5''' - ''July 23<sup>rd</sup> - August 31<sup>st</sup>, 2025''
** 10 teams are split into two groups based on Round 1-2 standings
*** Top 5 teams from round 1-2 are assigned to '''Legend Group'''
*** Bottom 5 teams from round 1-2 are assigned to '''Rise Group'''
** Triple round-robin
** Records from Rounds 1-2 are carried over.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** {{bgcolortext|seedup|Top 2 teams}} from Legend Group advance to Playoffs Round 2
** {{bgcolortext|up|{{Ordinal|3-4}} teams}} from Legend Group advance to Playoffs Round 1
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|Bottom team}} from Legend Group and {{bgcolortext|stayup|top 3 teams}} from Rise Group advance to Play-In
** {{bgcolortext|stay|Bottom two teams}} from Rise Group are eliminated
* '''Play-In''' - ''September 3<sup>rd</sup> - 7<sup>th</sup>, 2025''
** Double Elimination
** Top two teams advance to Playoffs Round 1
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
* '''Playoffs''' - ''September 10<sup>th</sup> - 28<sup>th</sup>, 2025''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** Top 3 teams qualify for [[World Championship/2025|Worlds]]
*** If [[Gen.G Esports]] (the MSI Champion) finishes in the top 3, the {{Ordinal|4}} place team qualifies for Worlds as the {{Ordinal|4}} seed of LCK
